Scenario: MOM Report entry is present in AR Reports left nav below Percent Collected Trend
Pre-conditions:
1. Navigate to https://revflow-dev.axgsolutions.com/
2. Signed in via Sign in with Microsoft as a user with the AR Reports permission
Test Data:
Nav label: MOM Report
Sibling label: Percent Collected Trend
Steps:
1. Verify the primary left navigation container is visible
2. Verify the AR Reports nav section is visible and enabled
3. Click the AR Reports nav section
4. Verify the Percent Collected Trend child link is visible
5. Verify the MOM Report child link is visible
6. Read the ordered list of AR Reports child link labels and locate the index of both links
Expected Result:
1. Left navigation container is rendered and visible
2. AR Reports section entry is visible and enabled
3. Section expands and its child report links become visible
4. Percent Collected Trend link is visible within AR Reports
5. MOM Report link is visible within AR Reports
6. Index of MOM Report is exactly one greater than the index of Percent Collected Trend (MOM Report sits directly below it)

Scenario: Pivot grid renders service months as rows and posting months as columns
Pre-conditions:
1. Signed in with AR Reports permission
2. On the MOM Report page with the default 12-month range applied
Test Data: Default range: 12 months
Steps:
1. Verify the pivot grid is visible
2. Verify the row header column is visible
3. Read all row header cell values
4. Verify the column header row is visible
5. Read all data column header values
6. Count the row headers and the data column headers
Expected Result:
1. Pivot grid container is visible
2. Row header column is visible and labelled for Service Date / Service Month
3. Every row header value is a service month label in MMM YYYY form
4. Column header row is visible and labelled for Posting Date / Posting Month
5. Every data column header is a posting month label in MMM YYYY form
6. Row count equals the selected service-range width (12) and data column count equals 12

Scenario: Posting date columns are ordered chronologically oldest to most recent
Pre-conditions:
1. On the MOM Report page
2. Default 12-month range applied
Test Data: Default range: 12 months
Steps:
1. Verify the column header row is visible
2. Read all data column header labels left to right
3. Parse each label into a comparable year-month value
4. Compare each parsed value with the one to its right
5. Verify no duplicate posting month appears in the header row
Expected Result:
1. Column header row is visible
2. A non-empty ordered list of posting month labels is returned
3. Every label parses successfully into a YYYY-MM value
4. Each value is strictly earlier than the value to its right (oldest leftmost, most recent rightmost)
5. All posting month headers are unique

Scenario: Cells where posting month is after the service month are populated
Pre-conditions:
1. On the MOM Report page
2. A service date range with known posted transaction data is applied
Test Data: Service range spanning 12 months of historical data
Steps:
1. Verify the pivot grid is visible and has at least one data row
2. Pick the first (oldest) service month row and read its row header
3. Identify every data column whose posting month is strictly after that service month
4. Read the cell value at each eligible column for that row
5. Verify each non-blank cell value format
6. Verify each percent value is within a valid range
Expected Result:
1. Pivot grid is visible with one or more data rows
2. Row header returns a parseable service month
3. A non-empty set of eligible columns is identified
4. Every eligible cell is non-blank
5. Each value renders as a percent collected figure (numeric with a % suffix)
6. Each value is greater than or equal to 0%

Scenario: Cells where posting month is on or before the service month are blank
Pre-conditions:
1. On the MOM Report page
2. Default 12-month range applied
Test Data: Default range: 12 months
Steps:
1. Verify the pivot grid is visible
2. Read every row header service month and every data column posting month
3. For each row, identify every column where posting month is earlier than the service month
4. Read the value of each cell identified in step 3
5. For each row, identify the column where posting month equals the service month, if present
6. Read the value of each equal-month cell
Expected Result:
1. Pivot grid is visible
2. Both ordered lists are returned and parseable
3. The set of earlier-posting-month cells is identified
4. Every such cell is blank (empty string or a blank placeholder)
5. Equal-month cells are identified where they exist
6. Every equal-month cell is blank - population requires posting month strictly after service month

Scenario: Each cell matches the Percent Collected Trend value for the equivalent Transactions Within scope
Pre-conditions:
1. Signed in with AR Reports permission
2. Same Global Facility Filter, Write-offs and Overpayments settings applied on both reports
Test Data:
Service month row: oldest month in range
Posting column: 1 month after that service month (equivalent Transactions Within = 1 month)
Steps:
1. Open the MOM Report and verify the pivot grid is visible
2. Read the row header of the oldest service month row
3. Read the cell value in the column exactly 1 month after that service month
4. Read the cell value in the column exactly 2 months after that service month
5. Navigate to the Percent Collected Trend report and verify its filter bar is visible
6. Set the same service date range and set Transactions Within to 1 month
7. Read the Percent Collected Trend value for the same service month
8. Change Transactions Within to 2 months and read the same service month value
9. Verify the cell values increase or stay level as the interval widens
Expected Result:
1. Pivot grid is visible
2. Service month is captured (e.g. Apr 2025)
3. A percent collected value is captured for the 1-month interval
4. A percent collected value is captured for the 2-month interval
5. Percent Collected Trend report loads with its filter bar visible
6. Report refreshes with the 1-month scope applied
7. Value equals the MOM Report value captured in step 3
8. Value equals the MOM Report value captured in step 4
9. The 2-month value is greater than or equal to the 1-month value (collection matures over time)

8. Last posting column is Apr 2025 - 1 month after the range end

Scenario: Export produces a file mirroring the pivot layout
Pre-conditions:
1. On the MOM Report page
2. Default 12-month range applied with populated data
3. User has export permission
Test Data: Export format as offered by the report (CSV / Excel)
Steps:
1. Verify the Export control is visible
2. Verify the Export control is enabled
3. Capture the on-screen row headers and column headers
4. Click the Export control
5. Wait for the download to complete and read the suggested filename
6. Open the exported file and read its header row
7. Read the first cell of each exported data row
8. Compare exported cell values against the on-screen grid
Expected Result:
1. Export control is visible on the MOM Report
2. Export control is enabled
3. On-screen service months and posting months are captured for comparison
4. Export is triggered and a file download begins
5. A file is downloaded with a non-empty filename and the expected extension
6. Header row lists the posting months in the same chronological order as the on-screen columns
7. Row labels are the service months in the same order as the on-screen rows
8. Values match the on-screen pivot, with blanks preserved where posting month is not strictly after the service month

Scenario: Export with an empty result set still produces a well-formed file
Pre-conditions:
1. On the MOM Report page
2. Filters applied that yield no matching transactions (e.g. a facility with no posted activity in the selected range)
Test Data: Facility / date range combination with zero results
Steps:
1. Apply a filter combination that returns no data and wait for the network to become idle
2. Verify the grid empty state
3. Verify the Export control state
4. Click Export if it is enabled
5. Open the exported file and read its header row
6. Read the file body
Expected Result:
1. Report refreshes and returns no data
2. Grid shows an empty state message or renders rows with all cells blank - no error is displayed
3. Export control remains visible and its state is deterministic (enabled, or disabled with a clear reason)
4. Export is triggered and a file download begins
5. Header row is present with the posting month columns intact
6. Body contains only blank / zero cells - no malformed rows and no unhandled error content
